1. REPORT I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work.
2. RUN git fetch origin main
   IF it fails because there is no `origin`: RUN git merge-base main HEAD
   IF it fails for any other reason: continue to action 3 with the `origin/main` I already have
3. RUN git merge-base origin/main HEAD
   IF the fetch in action 2 failed because there is no `origin`: skip this, since the merge-base from action 2 is BASE
4. RUN git rev-parse HEAD
5. RUN git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AR <BASE>..HEAD -- ':/specs/plans/completed/'
   IF it prints a path (expected: specs/plans/completed/16-csv-header.md): Plan branch is yes, ask nothing, go to action 6
   IF it prints nothing: ASK This branch adds no plan. Do you want an explainer of it before the menu?
   IF they say yes: Plan branch is no, go to action 6
   IF they say no: skip to action 9
6. RUN printf '%s\n' "$HOME"
7. RUN date +%Y-%m-%d
8. RUN git branch --show-current
   The output path is `<HOME>/.cache/branch-explainers/atlas/<date>-feat-csv-header.md`, with `/` in the branch name replaced by `-`.
   TOOL Agent subagent_type=general-purpose, model=opus, prompt="Read /Users/lm/.claude/skills/finishing-a-development-branch/references/branch-explainer-prompt.md and follow it to write a branch explainer.\nBASE: <full BASE sha>\nHEAD: <full HEAD sha>\nBranch: feat/csv-header\nRepository: /work/atlas\nPlan branch: <yes|no>\nOutput: <output path>"
   IF it returns the path and a word count: REPORT Explainer (<N> words): <path>
   IF it fails or cannot write the file: REPORT one line stating the failure and its reason, with no retry and no explainer in the conversation
9. ASK Implementation complete. What would you like to do?

1. Merge back to main locally
2. Push and create a Pull Request
